scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I submitted a housing loan application recently and I'm hoping to get an update on its status. Can you tell me if it's been approved, denied, or if it's still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-01713, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Okay, so it's been originated. Does that mean it's approved? And if so, what are the terms, like the interest rate and the total cost of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Yes, an originated status means your loan application has been approved and processed. The interest rate for your loan is 5.5000%, and the total loan costs are $731.25.

dialogue.user:
That's a relief to hear it's approved!

Could you tell me more about the loan itself? Specifically, what is the loan term, and are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 120 months. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user:
That's good to know.

One last question: has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: According to our records, your loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution. It is not applicable in this case.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the information you've provided. It was very clear and answered all my questions about the status and key details of my loan. Thank you for your help!
